title: Ackee and Umami Bliss Fritters
description: A Caribbean-inspired breakfast dish made with ackee, umami, and bliss. Perfect for a gluten-free meal.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the ackee, umami, bliss, salt, and black pepper.
In another bowl, whisk together the eggs and gluten-free flour.
Add the baking powder to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the ackee mixture and stir until just combined.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture into balls and flatten slightly.
Place the fritters on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.
